instruction: Write a ConfigMap with log4j2.xml configuration content.
output:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: log4j-config
data:
  log4j2.xml: |
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <Configuration>
      <Appenders>
        <Console name="Console" target="SYSTEM_OUT"/>
      </Appenders>
      <Loggers>
        <Root level="info">
          <AppenderRef ref="Console"/>
        </Root>
      </Loggers>
    </Configuration>
